_about: Stage B's fishing and cooking (scripts/camp/camp_pockets.gd). A player fishes within the radius (metres) of a water model's centre in data/clearing.json and grills at a fire model's; each takes cast_s or cook_s of real time and never fails. A catch is picked by weight. Grilling turns the first raw fish in your pockets into its recipe. Pockets hold pockets_max items; nothing is ever lost (a full pocket just can't take more). items: each item's kind (fish or meal), which requests ask for (data/guests.json). The bobber shows where the line is while fishing, cast_m ahead of the player.
